verdict.rationale: First-party docs and probes show a marketplace of roughly 64k ready-made Actors in Apify Store. The client docs state that Store Actors can be run directly, with a code example calling 'apify/web-scraper' and waiting for the run to finish. Community comments praise the product but do not specifically corroborate the marketplace-run workflow, so missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running Store Actors instead of building scrapers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch

citations.quote: You can run both your own Actors and Actors from Apify Store.
Thousands of ready-made Actors to automate yo
